# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Set amidst approx. 0.64 acres of beautifully manicured gardens, Pine Hurst is an exceptional detached residence offering privacy, space, and tranquillity just 800m from the heart of Barna village. This impressive five-bedroom home combines the charm of a peaceful countryside setting with the convenience of one of Galway's most sought-after coastal locations.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 5 bed
- Plocha: 248 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: Pine Hurst, Trusky West, Barna
- Cena: 950 000 €
